bracket.definitionKo: 특별한 내용의 글을 구분하기 위해 사방을 둘러서 막은 선의 안.
bracket.englishDescription: A space enclosed by four lines used to separate a certain section of writing from the rest of the text.

dwitgan.definitionKo: 뒷간이 나쁜 냄새가 나기 때문에 멀리 있을수록 좋은 것처럼 사돈집 사이에는 말이 나돌기 쉬우므로 서로 멀어야 한다.
dwitgan.englishExpression: The dwigan/dwitgan, an outhouse, and the house of one's-in-laws should be distant; Good fences make good neighbors
dwitgan.englishDescription: Just like an outhouse should be as far away as possible because of the smell, so too should the house of one's in-laws be far away since rumors spread.

dwitgan.headword: 뒷간에 갈 적 마음 다르고 올 적 마음 다르다
dwitgan.definitionKo: 자기 일이 급할 때는 간절히 매달리다가 일을 무사히 다 마치고 나면 모른 체한다.
dwitgan.englishExpression: have a certain state of mind when going into the dwigan/dwitgan, an outhouse, but have a different state of mind when coming out of it
dwitgan.englishDescription: For one to beg someone desperately for help when his/her help is urgently needed, but to ignore him/her after things have finished and their troubles have ended.

guest.englishDescription: A person who appears on a broadcast show on invitation.

gypsy.definitionKo: 헝가리를 중심으로 유럽, 서부 아시아, 아프리카, 미국에 퍼져 사는 유랑 민족.
gypsy.englishDescription: A nomadic tribe scattered throughout Europe, especially in Hungary, and in Western Asia, Africa, and America.

gypsy.definitionKo: (비유적으로) 한군데 머무르지 않고 이리저리 떠돌아다니는 사람.
gypsy.englishDescription: (figurative) A person who travels here and there, rather than settling down in an area.

jakarta.definitionKo: 인도네시아 자바섬 서북쪽에 위치한 인도네시아의 수도. 항구 도시이며 상업과 공업이 발달하였다.
jakarta.englishDescription: The capital of Indonesia, located in the northwest of Java Island, Indonesia; it is a port city with developed commerce and industry.

kilometer.englishDescription: A bound noun that serves as a unit of length.
A bound noun that serves as a unit of length.

pendant.definitionKo: 가운데에 보석으로 된 장식을 달아 가슴에 늘어뜨리게 만든 목걸이.
pendant.englishDescription: A necklace, with a jewel hanging from its center over one's chest.

rap.definitionKo: 강렬하고 반복적인 리듬에 맞춰 빠르게 말하듯이 노래하는 대중음악.
rap.englishDescription: Popular music that is sung as if spoken quickly to a strong and repetitive rhythm.

show.definitionKo: 라디오나 텔레비전 등에서 시간별로 나뉘어 방송되는 내용. 또는 그 차례나 목록.
show.englishDescription: The content that is broadcast on a radio or television by time, or the order or list of such programming.

signal.definitionKo: 몸짓이나 눈짓 등으로 의사를 전달함. 또는 그런 동작.
signal.englishDescription: Conveying meaning through gestures or eye contact. Or such actions.

touch.englishDescription: An act of placing one’s hand on or stroking something with a hand.

wink.definitionKo: 상대에게 무언가를 넌지시 알리거나 상대의 관심을 끌기 위해서 한쪽 눈을 깜빡거림.
wink.englishDescription: Blinking one eye, to secretly inform someone of something, or to attract the attention of someone of the opposite sex.
